body.name: Admissible balanced covariance tensors
body.construction: \[\mathfrak K^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K}=\left\{\Omega:\exists p\in\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K},\quad \Omega_{abij}=\sum_{z\in\mathcal Z_{N,K}}p(z)\{K\mathbf 1(z_i=a)-1\}\{K\mathbf 1(z_j=b)-1\}\right\}.\] This finite moment-polytope representation is the exact feasibility constraint. Every member satisfies the covariance symmetry \(\Omega_{abij}=\Omega_{baji}\); the arm-sum identities \(\sum_a\Omega_{abij}=\sum_b\Omega_{abij}=0\); the fixed-count unit-sum identities \(\sum_i\Omega_{abij}=\sum_j\Omega_{abij}=0\); the same-unit identities \(\Omega_{aaii}=K-1\) and \(\Omega_{abii}=-1\) for \(a\neq b\); the bounds \(-1\leq\Omega_{abij}\leq K-1\); and positive semidefiniteness of the \(NK\times NK\) matrix indexed by \((a,i)\). No further permutation symmetry is imposed, and the listed identities without the displayed probability-simplex representation are not taken as sufficient for feasibility.
